commit.message:
share: connection pool shutdowns

When closing a share with a connection pool, do not run the shutdown
sequences even once as there is no "multi" to operate on. Just terminate
the connections.

multi.c: handle a call to `Curl_multi_connchanged()` with a NULL
argument.

test_60_05: check shutdown in parallel mode that has the
connection pool at the multi handle, not a share.

Closes #23404
